Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred because the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly identify the specific URL required to access the Wayback Machine archives for the Virtue restaurant. Instead of using the correct domain (virtuerestaurant.com), the agent repeatedly entered incorrect or malformed URLs (e.g., "www.virtuerestaurant.com", "virtuerestaurant.com" without the 'w', or "https://www.virtuerestaurant.com/menus"). This fundamental failure to locate the correct web address prevented the agent from accessing the necessary historical menu data, leading to a loop of unsuccessful search attempts and ultimately an inability to answer the user's question. This matches the pattern of "Failure to use correct search terms" and "Repetitive Actions" seen in the reference examples.
